descriptionNullable:
A candidate pool of 149,983 unique small molecules from the LOTUS natural-products database, cleaned with RDKit 2026.03.3 for the Enveda CASMI 2026 molecule identification competition.

Columns: `smiles` (canonical, 2D, largest fragment, neutralised), `inchikey14` (connectivity block, the competition scoring key), `formula`, `monoisotopic_mass` (Da), `source` (LOTUS).

Built from the LOTUS frozen metadata (Zenodo record 19360665, CC0). Filtered to 100-1500 Da and deduplicated on inchikey14. Stereochemistry is removed, so molecules that differ only in stereo are merged.

See README.md in the dataset for the full build steps, counts and caveats.
